questions.q: Who is the author of the story 'Sun and Moon'?
questions.explanation: 'Sun and Moon' की लेखिका प्रसिद्ध कथाकार कैथरीन मैंसफील्ड (Katherine Mansfield) हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Who are 'Sun' and 'Moon' in the story?
questions.explanation: कहानी में 'सन' और 'मून' दो छोटे बच्चों (भाई-बहन) के नाम हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What major event was taking place at Sun and Moon's house?
questions.explanation: बच्चों के घर पर एक शानदार दावत (grand dinner party) की तैयारी चल रही थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What was the name of the nurse who took care of Sun and Moon?
questions.explanation: बच्चों की देखभाल करने वाली आया/नर्स का नाम हन्ना (Nurse Hannah) था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What special dessert caught the children's admiration in the kitchen?
options: A bowl of strawberry ice cream
An ice pudding shaped like a little pink house
questions.explanation: रसोई में गुलाबी रंग के एक छोटे से घर के आकार की आइस पुडिंग रखी हुई थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How did Sun and Moon dress up for the evening party?
options: Sun wore a black suit and Moon wore a red saree
Sun wore a white Russian blouse and Moon wore a white frock
questions.explanation: सन ने सफेद रशियन ब्लाउज और मून ने सफेद फ्रॉक पहनी थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What did the guests do when Sun and Moon were brought into the living room?
options: They admired and praised the children
questions.explanation: मेहमानों ने बच्चों को देखकर उनकी खूब तारीफ की और उन्हें प्यार किया।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What happened when the children were brought back to the dining room after the guests left?
options: The beautiful dining table was in complete mess and disorder
questions.explanation: मेहमानों के जाने के बाद डाइनिंग टेबल पूरी तरह अस्त-व्यस्त और जूठी थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Why did little Moon start crying loudly at the end of the party?
options: Because the little pink ice house had been broken and eaten
questions.explanation: मून रोने लगी क्योंकि पुडिंग वाले सुंदर छोटे से घर को तोड़कर खा लिया गया था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does the story 'Sun and Moon' highlight?
options: The adult world of artificiality and parties as seen through innocent child eyes
questions.explanation: यह कहानी बच्चों की मासूमियत और बड़ों की बनावटी दुनिया के बीच के अंतर को दर्शाती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Who is the author of the story 'Two Horizons'?
questions.explanation: 'Two Horizons' (दो क्षितिज) की लेखिका प्रसिद्ध ओडिया कथाकार बीना पाणी मोहंती (Bina Pani Mohanty) हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the central relationship explored in 'Two Horizons'?
options: The relationship between a teacher and student
The relationship between a husband and wife
The relationship between a mother and her daughter
questions.explanation: इस कहानी में एक माँ और उसकी बेटी के बीच के आत्मीय संबंध को दर्शाया गया है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Through what medium do the mother and daughter communicate in the story?
questions.explanation: माँ और बेटी आपस में पत्रों (Letters) के माध्यम से संवाद करती हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does the 'mother' represent in 'Two Horizons'?
options: Traditional values, endurance, and quiet suffering
questions.explanation: माँ पारंपरिक मूल्यों, सहनशीलता और मौन संघर्ष का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does the 'daughter' represent in the story?
options: Modern aspirations, education, and the search for identity
questions.explanation: बेटी आधुनिक आकांक्षाओं, उच्च शिक्षा और अपनी पहचान की तलाश को दर्शाती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Why is the daughter feeling disheartened in her letters?
options: Because she feels overwhelmed by the burdens and compromises of married life
questions.explanation: विवाह के बाद जीवन की जिम्मेदारियों और समझौतों से बेटी अत्यंत हताश महसूस करती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What advice does the mother give to her daughter in her reply?
options: To be strong, endure hardships, and find inner peace
questions.explanation: माँ बेटी को धैर्य रखने, मजबूत बनने और आंतरिक शांति खोजने की सलाह देती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does the title 'Two Horizons' symbolize?
options: The two different generations and worldviews of women
questions.explanation: 'दो क्षितिज' महिलाओं की दो अलग-अलग पीढ़ियों और उनके दृष्टिकोणों का प्रतीक है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How does the daughter view her mother's life of silent sacrifice?
options: She wants to copy it exactly
She respects it but does not want to live the same suffocating life
She thinks her mother was foolish
questions.explanation: बेटी माँ के त्याग का सम्मान करती है पर खुद वैसा घुटन भरा जीवन नहीं जीना चाहती।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the emotional tone of 'Two Horizons'?
questions.explanation: कहानी का स्वर अत्यंत विचारशील, मार्मिक और संवेदनशील (poignant) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Who is the author of the story 'Love Defiled'?
questions.explanation: 'Love Defiled' (कलंकित प्रेम) के लेखक गिरिधर झा (Giridhar Jha) हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Who is the narrator of the story 'Love Defiled'?
options: A young man who aspires to become an IAS officer
questions.explanation: कहानी का वक्ता एक युवा पुरुष है जो IAS अधिकारी बनने की तैयारी कर रहा है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Who supported the narrator emotionally and financially during his days of struggle?
questions.explanation: संघर्ष के दिनों में उसकी प्रेमिका ने उसे आर्थिक और मानसिक रूप से पूरा सहयोग दिया था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What prestigious examination did the narrator finally pass?
questions.explanation: वक्ता ने अंततः प्रतिष्ठित सिविल सेवा परीक्षा (IAS) पास कर ली।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How did the narrator's attitude change after becoming an IAS officer?
options: He gave all his money to the poor
He became arrogant, egoistic, and calculating
questions.explanation: IAS बनते ही वक्ता के भीतर अहंकार और घमंड आ गया; वह स्वार्थी हो गया।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Why did the narrator hesitate to marry his devoted girlfriend after his success?
options: He felt she was not up to his new 'elite' status and wanted a rich dowry
questions.explanation: उसे लगने लगा कि प्रेमिका उसके नए 'एलीट' स्तर के योग्य नहीं है और वह दहेज का लोभी हो गया।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How did the girlfriend react when she realized the narrator's change of heart?
options: She begged him to marry her
She behaved with immense dignity and walked out of his life
questions.explanation: प्रेमिका ने आत्मसम्मान दिखाया और बिना कोई तमाशा किए उसके जीवन से दूर चली गई।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What did the narrator realize years later when he reflected on his life?
options: That his ego had destroyed true love and left him empty
That he had made the best decision
questions.explanation: सालों बाद वक्ता को अहसास हुआ कि उसके झूठे घमंड ने सच्चे प्रेम को नष्ट कर दिया।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does the word 'Defiled' mean in the context of the story?
options: Corrupted or polluted by greed and ego
questions.explanation: 'Defiled' का अर्थ है स्वार्थ, दहेज और अहंकार के कारण पवित्र प्रेम का कलंकित होना।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the central moral of 'Love Defiled'?
options: True love is priceless and should never be sacrificed for vanity or worldly status
questions.explanation: सच्चा प्रेम अनमोल है और उसे कभी भी झूठे रुतबे या अहंकार के लिए नहीं खोना चाहिए।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'The Pace for Living', what does R.C. Hutchinson say about his enjoyment of rapid motion in a car?
options: He enjoys driving at 10 miles an hour
He likes sleeping in the car
He enjoys it at 90 miles an hour, provided he is not driving
questions.explanation: हचिंसन कहते हैं कि उन्हें 90 मील प्रति घंटे की रफ्तार पसंद है, बशर्ते कार उनकी न हो और वे खुद न चला रहे हों।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What fantastic notion did the corn-merchant's wife have in 'The Pace for Living'?
questions.explanation: अनाज व्यापारी की पत्नी को छुट्टी पर 10 पाउंड खर्च करने की अजीब आदत थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Where does the author of 'The Pace for Living' mention dining and lunching?
options: Dining in Tokyo and lunching in Delhi
Dining in London and lunching in New York next day
Dining in Paris and lunching in Rome
Dining in Dublin and lunching in London
questions.explanation: पाठ में लेखक लंदन में रात का खाना और अगले दिन न्यूयॉर्क में दोपहर का खाना खाने का जिक्र करते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: According to R.C. Hutchinson, what do modern machines do to us?
options: They drive us to move faster
questions.explanation: आधुनिक मशीनें मनुष्य को और अधिक तेज़ गति से भागने के लिए मजबूर करती हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the central theme of 'The Pace for Living'?
options: The agony of modern man in a fast-paced world
questions.explanation: इस पाठ का मुख्य विषय आधुनिक मनुष्य की तेज़ रफ्तार जिंदगी से उपजी पीड़ा (agony) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'Me and the Ecology Bit', what does Jim collect from houses for recycling?
questions.explanation: जिम रीसायकल करने के लिए लोगों के घरों से पुराने अखबार (old newspapers) इकट्ठा करता था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Why does Mrs. Greene refuse to give Jim the old newspapers?
options: She says her husband needs them
questions.explanation: मिसेज ग्रीन कहती हैं कि उनके पति को वे अखबार चाहिए, इसलिए वे जिम को नहीं देतीं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does Jim say about his mother's electric mixer?
questions.explanation: जिम अपनी माँ से कहता है कि इलेक्ट्रिक मिक्सर से बिजली की बर्बादी (wastes electricity) होती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How does Jim's mother react to his lecture on electricity?
options: She tells him to turn off his TV
questions.explanation: माँ जिम को ताना मारती है कि वह खुद दिनभर टीवी चलाकर बिजली बर्बाद करता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the ultimate irony shown in 'Me and the Ecology Bit'?
options: Everyone wants ecology but nobody wants to work for it
questions.explanation: कहानी का व्यंग्य यह है कि पर्यावरण की बातें सब करते हैं पर उसके लिए काम कोई नहीं करना चाहता।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: The teacher said to the boys, 'Sit down.'
options: The teacher requested the boys to sit down.
The teacher told the boys that sit down.
The teacher ordered the boys to sit down.
The teacher asked the boys sit down.
questions.explanation: Imperative में 'said to' को 'ordered' में और Verb के पहले 'to' (to sit down) लगाते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said to me, 'Please help me.'
options: He requested me to help him.
He ordered me to help him.
He told me that please help him.
He asked me to please help him.
questions.explanation: 'Please' वाले वाक्यों में 'said to' को 'requested' में बदलकर 'to + V1' जोड़ते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: The doctor said to the patient, 'Do not eat oily food.'
options: The doctor told the patient not eat oily food.
The doctor ordered the patient do not eat oily food.
The doctor forbade the patient not to eat oily food.
The doctor advised the patient not to eat oily food.
questions.explanation: नकारात्मक सलाह में 'advised... not to + V1' का प्रयोग होता है। ('forbade' के साथ 'not' नहीं लगता)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: Father said to his son, 'Don't go out in the sun.'
options: Father asked his son not go out in the sun.
Father forbade his son to go out in the sun.
Father forbade his son not to go out in the sun.
Father ordered his son don't go out in the sun.
questions.explanation: 'forbade' (मना करना) खुद नकारात्मक है, अतः इसके बाद सीधे 'to + V1' (to go out) लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, 'Let us go for a walk.'
options: He ordered that they should go for a walk.
He told that let us go for a walk.
He asked to go for a walk.
He proposed that they should go for a walk.
questions.explanation: 'Let us' वाले वाक्यों में 'proposed/suggested that... should' का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, 'Alas! I am undone.'
options: He exclaimed with sorrow that he was undone.
He told that he is undone.
He said with sorrow that I am undone.
He exclaimed with joy that he was undone.
questions.explanation: 'Alas!' दुख का सूचक है, अतः 'exclaimed with sorrow' का प्रयोग होगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: They said, 'Hurrah! We have won the match.'
options: They exclaimed with joy that they have won the match.
They exclaimed with joy that they had won the match.
They told with joy that we have won the match.
They exclaimed with sorrow that they had won the match.
questions.explanation: 'Hurrah!' खुशी का सूचक है, अतः 'exclaimed with joy' और Tense नियमानुसार बदलेगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, 'What a beautiful picture it is!'
options: He exclaimed with joy that it was a very beautiful picture.
He exclaimed with joy what a beautiful picture it was.
He told that it is a beautiful picture.
He asked that it was a very beautiful picture.
questions.explanation: Exclamatory वाक्यों को Assertive (it was a very beautiful picture) में बदल दिया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: She said, 'How fast he is running!'
options: She exclaimed how fast he was running.
She told that he is running very fast.
She asked that he was running very fast.
She exclaimed that he was running very fast.
questions.explanation: 'How fast' बदलकर 'very fast' हो जाएगा और वाक्य साधारण बन जाएगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: The general said to the soldiers, 'March forward!'
options: The general told the soldiers that march forward.
The general commanded the soldiers to march forward.
The general asked soldiers march forward.
The general requested the soldiers to march forward.
questions.explanation: सेनाधिकारी के निर्देश के लिए 'commanded... to + V1' का प्रयोग सबसे उत्तम है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: The captain, along with his team members, ________ present.
questions.explanation: जब दो Subject 'along with', 'as well as', 'with' से जुड़े हों, तो Verb हमेशा पहले Subject (The captain - Singular) के अनुसार लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: Neither Ram nor his brothers ________ come.
questions.explanation: 'Neither... nor' में Verb हमेशा पास वाले Subject (his brothers - Plural) के अनुसार लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: Either the teacher or the students ________ to blame.
questions.explanation: यहाँ पास वाला Subject 'the students' Plural है, अतः Plural Verb (are) लगेगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: Many a man ________ tempted by gold.
questions.explanation: 'Many a + Singular Noun' के साथ हमेशा Singular Verb (is/was) का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: The jury ________ divided in their opinions.
questions.explanation: जब Collective Noun (jury) के सदस्यों में मतभेद हो (divided in opinions), तो Plural Verb (were) लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: The jury ________ selected its chairman.
questions.explanation: जब Collective Noun एकमत होकर कार्य करे (its chairman), तो Singular Verb (has) लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: More than one person ________ involved in the accident.
questions.explanation: 'More than one + Singular Noun' के साथ Singular Verb (was) का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: Nothing but trees ________ seen there.
questions.explanation: 'Nothing but' के बाद Noun चाहे Plural हो (trees), Verb हमेशा Singular (was) ही रहता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: Two-thirds of the book ________ been read.
questions.explanation: जब भिन्न (fraction) के बाद Singular Uncountable Noun (book) हो, तो Singular Verb (has) लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: Two-thirds of the books ________ damaged.
questions.explanation: जब भिन्न के बाद Plural Countable Noun (books) हो, तो Plural Verb (were) लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the synonym of 'Fascinating'?
questions.explanation: 'Fascinating' (आकर्षक/मनमोहक) का पर्यायवाची 'Charming' है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the antonym of 'Barren'?
questions.explanation: 'Barren' (बंजर) का विलोम 'Fertile' (उपजाऊ) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the synonym of 'Lament'?
questions.explanation: 'Lament' (विलाप करना) का पर्यायवाची 'Mourn' (शोक मनाना) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: जब मैं स्टेशन पहुँचा, ट्रेन जा चुकी थी।
options: When I reach station, the train left.
When I was reaching station, train had left.
When I reached station, the train has left.
When I reached the station, the train had left.
questions.explanation: भूतकाल की दो घटनाओं में पहले होने वाली घटना के लिए Past Perfect (had left) लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: यदि तुम कठिन परिश्रम करोगे, तो परीक्षा पास कर लोगे।
options: If you will work hard, you will pass the exam.
If you work hard, you will pass the exam.
If you worked hard, you pass the exam.
If you working hard, you will pass exam.
questions.explanation: शर्त वाले वाक्यों (First Conditional) में 'If + Present Simple', दूसरे भाग में 'will + V1' लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: डॉक्टर के आने से पहले रोगी मर चुका था।
options: The patient has died before the doctor came.
The patient died before the doctor came.
The patient was dying before the doctor came.
The patient had died before the doctor came.
questions.explanation: यह अंग्रेजी का अत्यंत प्रसिद्ध वाक्य है: 'The patient had died before the doctor came.'
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: क्या तुम जानते हो कि वह कहाँ रहता है?
options: Are you know where he lives?
Do you know where he lives?
Do you know where he live?
Do you know where does he live?
questions.explanation: Complex sentence में प्रश्नवाचक भाग (Do you know) के बाद दूसरा भाग साधारण (where he lives) होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the antonym of 'Crucial'?
questions.explanation: 'Crucial' (अति-महत्वपूर्ण) का विलोम 'Trivial' (तुच्छ/मामूली) है।

questions.q: What is the synonym of 'Profound'?
